title: A Aftermath for the Blue Hour
author: August Sterling
blurb: Astrid Ravensworth, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
